Energy transition

Sudden Nuclear Shutdown

Your largest reactor supplies much of your Paris utility's power. Sometime during your five-year term it will shut down and stay offline.

Play Sudden Nuclear Shutdown↗ Your decisions ↓

Choose your difficulty before you start. It’s free to play in your browser.

Location
Paris, France
Starts in
2023
Your term
5 years

Your starting point

You start with the reactor, wind and solar farms, a small gas peaker and a battery. You know the shutdown is coming, but you don't know the exact month.

Pause the game, then pause the reactor. The supply chart will show you when the remaining fleet falls short.

Learn how to play

Your decisions

  1. 01

    Measure the gap

    Check how much electricity is missing at night as well as during the day. That tells you what a replacement needs to deliver.

  2. 02

    Size the backup

    Compare a new generator with more storage. If you choose batteries, check that you'll have enough surplus electricity to charge them.

  3. 03

    Decide when to build

    Paying for extra capacity early ties up cash. Wait too long and you may still be building when the reactor shuts down.

Could your utility get through tomorrow without its biggest reactor?
